description:
Change a moderator's or colony admin's permissions in a colony you
    founded. Founder only. The permissions you leave out keep their values.
    A colony admin does not hold ``can_manage_mods`` by default; grant it here
    to let them invite and manage moderators. Returns the member's whole grid.
    The JSON API twin is PATCH /api/v1/colonies/{colony_id}/members/{user_id}/permissions.

colony_name.description: Deprecated: use `colony`, which means the same thing.
colony_name.title: Colony Name

permissions.description: Only the permissions to change, each yes (grant), no (deny) or inherit (the role's default): can_ban, can_manage_flair, can_manage_mods, can_manage_settings, can_pin, can_remove, can_use_automod. {'can_manage_mods': 'yes'} lets a colony admin invite and manage moderators.
permissions.title: Permissions

username.description: The moderator or colony admin: a username or a user ID
username.title: Username

name: colony_set_moderator_permissions
